seam_patch: Eight-texel opposing edge bands blend to their shared midpoint at the border. All four source trunks retained; exact x/y border pixels match.
topology: One96px-wide connected footprint in256px square cell; top is lifted56px. Three-by-three context includes connected-neighbor return arms before extrusion, outline and crop.
cap_interpretation: Continuous restrained packed-mud cap, using fine low-contrast grit from the generated mud gap. This is an authored interpretation; exact original top construction is not known. Replaces rejected oversized repeated circles.
color_extraction: Neutral source shading in primary w. Independent neutral detail-alpha from bright ridges/caps receives native y; no color baked into atlas.
coverage: Primary owns solid body alpha; detail stays within it. Connected boundaries are evaluated before cropping, preventing new endpoint caps/outline seams at every cell border.
